Summary: in October, detached homes in South Surrey and White Rock sold at a median of $1,552,500, down from $1,628,000 in September, and buyers had far more detached listings than sales. Condos and townhomes held at a $700,000 median and sold faster. These numbers cover all homes, not just new ones; the board does not report new construction separately.
A sales ratio under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

Are presales listed on the MLS®?
Some are, many are not. Developers often sell presales directly through a presentation centre. Ask me and I can check any South Surrey project for you.
What protection does a BC presale buyer have?

Under BC's Real Estate Development Marketing Act, the developer must give you a disclosure statement before you sign, and you can cancel by written notice within 7 days. Source: BC Financial Services Authority, Presales Information.
Do I pay property transfer tax on a new South Surrey home?
Not on a qualifying principal residence up to $1,100,000 under BC's Newly Built Home Exemption, with a partial exemption to $1,150,000.
Can first-time buyers get the GST back?
Yes. The federal First-Time Home Buyers' GST Rebate refunds the full 5% GST on a qualifying new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000). See my
How much deposit does a South Surrey presale need?
Most projects ask for 10% to 20% in staged instalments during construction, held in trust until completion.
Is transit improving in South Surrey?
King George Boulevard bus rapid transit is being designed from Surrey City Centre to Semiahmoo Town Centre (City of Surrey, May 2026).
Does it cost more to use a Realtor for a presale?
No. The developer pays the buyer's agent fees. Register with me before your first presentation-centre visit so I can represent you.
